notes_summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick rollout; running POC to validate latency and unit-costs. Interested in Dedicated if reserve capacity yields >20% cost savings. Highly cost-sensitive, wants clear quantization and batching recommendations.
notes: Intro & qualification: 2025-01-10 demo of Hosted API. Liked streaming + function-calls. 'We need predictable p95 latency for live chat flows', Rhea
POC scope: embeddings for product docs (10k docs), chat assistance for support agents, and a reranking pipeline for search results.
Targets: chat p95 < 250ms for common queries; sustained throughput ~120 reqs/sec during peak; embedding batch jobs run nightly (~3M tokens/day).
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Team wants unit economics per 1k tokens and per-embedding cost. Explicit ask: show tradeoffs hosted vs reserved Dedicated with quantized 4-bit & 8-bit profiles.
Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration. Data residency: prefer US first, EU later for enterprise customers. Legal flagged retention clause (blocker).
Tech preferences: prefer smaller quantized model for chat (7B/13B) with fallback to 30B for high-value prompts. Expect automatic routing/fallback if capacity constrained.
Operational asks: per-route dashboards, tracing for latency spikes, token-level cost breakdowns. POC must include end-to-end tracing and cost dashboard sample.
Quote from CTO: 'If you can get our per-session cost below $0.02 and hit p95 targets, we can commit to Dedicated next quarter.'
